messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Hi @Daniel — quick manager-friendly first-week + 30/60/90 checklist for Zoe who starts Monday. Kept it short: copy/paste into calendar.

Daniel (Eng Manager): Got it, I can own code walkthrough + pairing. Will confirm mentor.

Aisha (People Ops): First-week (copyable):
Day 0: laptop shipped, SSO invite, Slack/channel access
Day 1 AM: HR paperwork + manager 1:1 (role context)
Day 1 PM: team intro, standup, verify VPN/badge
Day 2: product & architecture overview, read-only repo access
Day 3: dev workflow, CI demo, assign tiny ticket (pairing)
Day 4: observability & deploy runbook, security checklist
Day 5: 1-week sync, set 30-day outcomes

Aisha (People Ops): 30/60/90 starter (measurable):
30d: merge 1 small change to staging; complete security training; meet key stakeholders
60d: own an end-to-end bugfix or small feature; present approach to team
90d: deliver measurable improvement or a process proposal; mentor shadowing

Ruth (IT): Laptop ETA Friday. SSO invite will be sent 24h before start. If VPN fails, run `vpn-check` and DM me logs.

Zoe (New Hire): Thanks, quick Q — who to ping for repo perms?

Daniel (Eng Manager): Ping me first. If infra-level, I'll escalate to Ruth/eng-infra. Include screenshot of 403.

Onboarding Bot: Calendar events created: "Zoe Week1: HR + Manager 1:1" Mon 09:00, "Repo Walkthrough" Tue 10:00, "Week1 Review" Fri 16:00.

Aisha (People Ops): Who-to-ask mini-cheatsheet: Laptop/SSO: Ruth (IT); Repo/CI perms: Daniel -> eng-infra; Payroll/benefits: Aisha; Security: Security team via manager.

Zoe (New Hire): All set, laptop tracking showed shipped. Appreciate the checklist! :smile:
